hero-description:
Lord, renew my spirit day by day.
Strengthen me with Your power in my inner being!
	 Refresh and restore my soul.
Fill me with Your peace and presence anew!
	 Revive my heart with a fresh passion for Jesus and a hunger for Your Word.
	 Renew my mind, O Lord.
Help me fix my thoughts on things above and set my mind on Your truth.
	 Heal and renew our weary bodies.
Give us new strength and vitality each day!
	 Renew this church, O God.
Let Your Spirit move in power among us, bringing revival and spiritual breakthrough!
Lord, renew us day by day!
